owner: ADVI_BILLING (AB-t-1 writes it; AB-t-2 reads it; AB-t-3 renders it)

contract_version.meaning: this contract's version; the object carries 0.1.0

relationship_id.meaning: dim_relationship relationship_id (rel_<hex>) holding the household's accounts; null if none holds them

client_key.meaning: the portal's household key = the Black Diamond relationship_id (z-prefixed) on the account fee lines, which names the served platinum client summary; also the object's file name

billing_convention.meaning: when the fee is billed relative to the value period

billing_convention_claim.meaning: how the value was come by; a consumer rejects on this field. measured = read from a named source by an instrument; inferred = derived from measured values by a stated rule; held = carried from an earlier record without re-reading; absent = no value could be had.

period_start.meaning: ISO date, first day of the billing period

period_end.meaning: ISO date, last day of the billing period

valuation_date.meaning: ISO date of the fact_rps values used, chosen by testing the candidates against the debits

as_of.meaning: UTC timestamp the object was computed

accounts.meaning: one row per account of the household

billable_value.meaning: USD, sum of fact_rps market_value_settled_unsettled for the account on valuation_date

schedule.meaning: the ADVISOR fee schedule applied: the account's own Black Diamond schedule (the BD fee line's account_fee_schedule / basis_points)

label.meaning: the BD account_fee_schedule label, e.g. '49F - Flat 1'

basis_points.meaning: the account's annual ADVISOR rate in basis points (100 = rate 0.0100), from the BD fee line

flat_fee.meaning: USD flat fee component; 0.0 when none

tiers.meaning: tier rows; [] when the schedule is flat

schedule_claim.meaning: how the account's ADVISOR schedule was come by; a consumer rejects on this field. measured = read from the BD fee line in the quarter's first month; inferred = the account has no fee line that month and the latest earlier line is used (schedule_source says so); held = carried from an earlier record without re-reading; absent = no value could be had.

schedule_source.meaning: the BD fee line the schedule was read from, by partition key

flow_adjustment.meaning: USD adjustment to billable_value for flows; 0.0 in 0.1.0 (flows are listed, not applied)

flows_in_period.meaning: EXTERNAL flows from the gold flow_ledger between valuation_date (exclusive) and the ADVISOR debit date (inclusive): {date, amount, note}; amount = signed USD, note = the ledger's class

excluded_value.meaning: USD of value excluded from billable_value; 0.0 in 0.1.0

exclusion_reason.meaning: why value was excluded; null when none

days_in_period.meaning: trading days in the billing period (NYSE calendar, lib/trading_calendar)

days_in_year.meaning: SMArtX year basis in trading days (251)

components.meaning: exactly two rows, ADVISOR and PLATFORM

portion.meaning: which fee: ADVISOR (the advisor's share, debited by Schwab as TPFEE) or PLATFORM (SMArtX, debited as SMFEE)

rate.meaning: annual rate as a fraction (0.0100 = 100 basis points) applied as value x rate x days_in_period / days_in_year; null only when the component's schedule_claim is absent (PLATFORM: the SMArtX schedule is not held in Opal)

debit_code.meaning: Schwab fact_trn tran_srcde that carries this portion's debit

computed_fee.meaning: USD, round(billable_value x rate x days_in_period / days_in_year, 2); null only when the component's schedule_claim is absent

debited_fee.meaning: USD, positive: abs(sum of gross_amount of this debit_code rows for the account on debit_date, Schwab master 0833 fact_trn); null when NO_DEBIT

debit_date.meaning: ISO date of the Schwab debit this component is compared with; null when NO_DEBIT

difference.meaning: USD, computed_fee - debited_fee: positive = Opal computed more than Schwab debited; null when NO_DEBIT or when computed_fee is null

reconcile_class.meaning: agreement with Schwab for this component; a component with a debit and no computed fee is DIFFERS with the reason that the schedule is not held

difference_reason.meaning: plain-English reason; REQUIRED (non-empty) when DIFFERS, null otherwise

schedule_claim.meaning: how this component's rate was come by (same enum as claim_enum): ADVISOR carries the account's schedule_claim; PLATFORM carries absent in 0.1.0 because no per-account SMArtX platform/model rate is held in Opal. A consumer rejects a null rate/computed_fee that does not carry absent.

billable_value.meaning: USD, sum of the accounts' billable_value

computed_fee.meaning: USD, sum of the non-null computed_fee over the components (0.1.0: the ADVISOR components)

debited_fee.meaning: USD, sum of debited_fee over the SAME components that have a computed_fee (NO_DEBIT counts 0.0), so the household comparison is like-for-like; the debits of components with no computed fee are on those components and in steps

difference.meaning: USD, computed_fee - debited_fee over the comparable components

reconcile_class.meaning: NO_DEBIT when no component has a debit; else MATCH when |difference| <= 0.01 else DIFFERS

steps.meaning: at least 3 plain-English lines an advisor reads to answer 'why is my fee this number?'

claim_enum.meaning: how the value was come by; a consumer rejects on this field. measured = read from a named source by an instrument; inferred = derived from measured values by a stated rule; held = carried from an earlier record without re-reading; absent = no value could be had.

members.NO_DEBIT: no Schwab row for the component's debit_code on its debit date; debit_date, debited_fee, difference are null
members.DIFFERS: a debit exists and |difference| > 0.01 USD, or a debit exists with no computed fee (schedule not held); difference_reason is required

rule_24_record.domain: one account or household x quarter, after the fee is computed
rule_24_record.i_mece: members from {debit present?} x {|diff| <= 0.01 or not computable}: absent -> NO_DEBIT; present and within -> MATCH; present and outside, or present and not computable -> DIFFERS; the fourth cell (absent and within) is unreachable because difference is null when absent. 2 x 2 grid, 4 cells, 3 members, 1 empty by construction.
rule_24_record.ii_same_grain: every member classifies the same unit: one component (account) or one household for the quarter
rule_24_record.iii_intent_coherence: one axis: agreement with Schwab's debit, not which side is right
rule_24_record.iv_state_coherence: a schedule fix moves computed_fee and so can move MATCH/DIFFERS; it never moves debited_fee, which is read from fact_trn, and never moves NO_DEBIT, which depends on Schwab alone

scope_note: 0.1.0 models neither the prior-quarter true-up carried on the 07-07 debit nor flows (flow_adjustment 0.0); both are named as reasons on a DIFFERS, not computed. The PLATFORM (SMArtX) schedule is not held in Opal: its component carries null rate and computed_fee, schedule_claim absent, and the SMFEE debit as measured.
amendment: AMENDMENT 1 (2.0.0_SA_COO~B2 2026-10-09): household key = BD relationship_id; ADVISOR rate = the account's own BD schedule; PLATFORM component with null rate and fee; flows_in_period {date, amount, note}.
